_comment: Knowledge budget ratchet CEILING (W1-T38, MASTER-PLAN §8A). Captured from the real active-lifecycle learnings/*.yaml corpus via `node scripts/learnings-budget-ratchet.mjs` -- the sum of every ACTIVE entry's injectable line (`- <fact> [src: learnings#<id>]`), superseded/quarantined entries excluded (they carry zero injection weight; see learnings/platform.yaml's header). capChars carries headroom over the measured figure for near-term retro growth. Never raise this to paper over an unreviewed dump of learnings -- raising the cap is a deliberate, reviewed change (like the coverage floor); a corpus-growing PR that blows through it must go CI-red on scripts/learnings-budget-ratchet.mjs until a compression pass (tighter facts, dedup, supersession) or a reviewed cap bump brings it back in budget. NOTE: this ratchet caps the CORPUS-WIDE injectable weight (every active entry summed); it is orthogonal to src/lib/learnings.ts's DEFAULT_KNOWLEDGE_BUDGET_CHARS, which caps what any ONE task's matched selection actually injects -- a corpus can grow here while what a given session pays stays flat or falls, because selectLearnings only injects entries whose files: glob matches that task.
bumpRationale: Raised 20000 -> 42000 by W1-T2507: CLAUDE.md's 84 bullets included several that each name a concrete repo path and duplicate exactly what learnings/ already exists to do -- inject a fact only to the task whose files: overlap it. 19 of those became new learnings/architecture.yaml entries (three more were drafted but reverted -- existing tests pin their exact prose inside CLAUDE.md itself, proving those particular facts are read by every task author regardless of files:, not just editors of the file they happen to name). Migrating the rest moves several thousand bytes of formerly UNCONDITIONAL per-session tax (CLAUDE.md is injected in full every run) into a corpus that only pays a task when its files: glob actually matches, which is the strict compression direction MASTER-PLAN §8A asks for even though the corpus's own raw total grows. The corpus-wide ratchet and the per-task injection budget (DEFAULT_KNOWLEDGE_BUDGET_CHARS, unchanged at 8148) are orthogonal: this raise affects only how large the addressable corpus may grow, never what any one session is charged. capChars keeps deliberate headroom (42000 against a measured 34641) for near-term retro growth, same shape as CLAUDE.md's own ratchet.
